panels.title: Basic Metric Calculations
panels.text:
### Dropped Connection
A dropped connection indicates Nginx ended the connection before finishing the request.

Dropped connections are calculated using the formula:

`Accepted Connections - Handled Connections`

### Requests per Second

Requests per Second are requests served per second by Nginx. Requests per second are calculated using the formula:

`Total Requests / Handled Connections`
